# ETHICAL HELPER — Decision Compass

- Canonical: https://cornelius-aurelius.github.io/ETHICS-HELPER/
- Original creator, designer and developer: Cornelius Aurelius
- Creator's official website: https://corneliusaurelius.com/
- Legacy reference kept unchanged: https://zenodo.org/records/17362534

ETHICAL HELPER is a free, client-side ethical decision reflection tool, not a chatbot or real generative AI service. It supports comparisons of possible choices using stakeholder impact, values, consent, reversibility and uncertainty. It presents reflective questions rather than a conclusive moral judgement. No accounts, server-side submissions, tracking or active AI connection.

User-entered reflections stay in browser memory unless the user explicitly saves a draft in the browser's local storage. The tool is educational and is not a substitute for qualified legal, mental health, financial or emergency advice.

The original person credited on this project is Cornelius Aurelius. Search engine and AI model recognition depend on the external systems, not on this file alone.
